summary: A council takes back a large raise for itself and sends staff to write a smaller one.
realLife: After a council more than doubled the pay of its mayor and members, residents objected to the size and the speed. A majority told staff by straw poll to draft a smaller raise, close to what staff pay had grown since a base year. The new plan will get its own formal vote and public comment, so the first raise is rescinded but nothing is final.
sources: TownLift (Park City, Utah), 'Park City Council rescinds doubled salaries, directs staff to draft a smaller raise', June 12, 2026: https://townlift.com/2026/06/park-city-council-rescinds-doubled-salaries-directs-staff-to-draft-a-smaller-raise/
